label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 129
title: Traceability view + API over the id hub (keeps id-only data; consumes backend index)
body:
## Original (as captured)
Consumes traceability.json id_index via API; table/matrix UI, undeclared-prefix findings, coverage gaps. Paired with the backend traceability hub item.

## Context (from linked item product_forge:BI-0151)
core/traceability.py now owns the hub (single writer of traceability.json -> id_index key, legacy matrix preserved). index_project/refresh_hub/get_hub scan each CANONICAL .md/.txt artifact with the canonical id query (declared families only; single-letter prose noise ignored; derived .html/.xlsx skipped). Records family/stage/agent/artifact/run_id/defined/refs; flags undeclared (invented) prefixes and computes coverage (must/KF<->feature<->requirement<->test). Back-filled existing artifacts (0,0a,0b) -> 106 ids, 0 undeclared. Wired into stage_runner (refresh on stage complete).
